items.t: Fuel pump can fail and cut engine power (recall)
Limp mode with 'Service Electronic Throttle' warning
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,130-$1,210 for 2017-2018 and about $600-$670 for 2019. Check the fuel pump recall first; it may cover this for free.

items.t: Misfires from failing ignition coils
items.note: RepairPal lists about $285-$348 for one coil; the service bulletin calls for replacing all four.

items.t: Coolant loss and burning coolant smell
items.note: A radiator leak is one cause; coolant mixing with oil is a much bigger engine repair.

items.t: Corroded ground straps can melt wiring
items.job: Replace ground straps and repair melted wiring harness
items.note: Owners reported quotes of about $6,450-$9,000 once wiring had melted. Catching corroded straps early costs far less.

items.t: Quadrifoglio limp mode from engine computer software
items.note: Software update by a dealer per service bulletin; usually covered by the factory warranty on a car this new.

items.t: Exterior trim moldings come loose
items.job: Refit or replace roof or rear door molding
items.note: Done by a dealer per service bulletin; usually covered by the factory warranty on a car this new.

items.t: Battery keeps going flat
items.note: RepairPal lists about $440-$480 for most years.
